personal_info.summary: Experienced software engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable web applications and cloud-based services. Strong background in full-stack development, distributed systems, and agile delivery. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with product and business stakeholders to ship high-quality software.

roles.title: Engineering Manager
roles.role_description: Lead a team of 15 engineers across backend, frontend, and platform domains. Responsible for roadmap delivery, team growth, and cross-functional alignment with product and business stakeholders.

responsibilities.description: Managed and grew a team of 15 engineers, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning.
Drove architectural modernization from a monolithic Rails app to event-driven microservices on AWS, reducing deployment lead time by 60%.
Partnered with product management to define quarterly roadmaps and OKRs, consistently achieving 85%+ delivery rate.
Established engineering standards including code review guidelines, testing requirements, and on-call practices.
Led hiring process end-to-end for 8 engineer roles over 2 years, improving offer acceptance rate through structured interview loops.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.role_description: Individual contributor focused on building and scaling the core platform API and data pipeline infrastructure.

responsibilities.description: Designed and implemented a high-throughput data ingestion pipeline processing 2M events/day using AWS Kinesis and Lambda.
Led migration of the primary relational database from MySQL to PostgreSQL, with zero downtime.
Built internal developer tooling that reduced local environment setup time from 2 hours to under 15 minutes.
Mentored 3 junior engineers and conducted technical onboarding for new hires.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.role_description: Full-stack engineer on a B2B SaaS analytics platform serving mid-market customers.

responsibilities.description: Developed new product features across the React frontend and Node.js/Express backend, shipping bi-weekly.
Implemented OAuth2 SSO integration with Okta, enabling enterprise customer adoption.
Improved API response times by 40% through query optimization and Redis caching.
Participated in on-call rotation and reduced mean time to resolution by documenting runbooks.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
roles.role_description: Early-stage startup building a consumer mobile app for personal finance management.

responsibilities.description: Built and maintained REST APIs in Python/Django consumed by iOS and Android clients.
Implemented automated unit and integration test suites, raising coverage from 20% to 75%.
Collaborated directly with the founding team to define and iterate on product features.

education_and_certifications.description: B.Sc. Computer Science, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
